about:
Writes tests/vectors/heartbeat-v4.json: every call of heartbeat.verify() that the v4 heartbeat tests
(tests/test_baremetal_heartbeat_v4.py) make, with what it was given and what it decided. The Go port is held
to the same rules: a quorum of heartbeat_signers, a party twice, a key not the party's, a node that does not
count, low-S, the single-key form refused under v4, the manifest's lifetime bound, and the owner's shorter one
(the lifetime is the heartbeat's own expires_at - issued_at, both in the case). A drift on either side fails
CI: the Python test replays this file too.

cases.name: Quorum.test_a_key_that_is_not_the_party_s_or_a_high_s_signature #1
cases.refused: signatures[0]: the key is not a's signing_key

cases.name: Quorum.test_a_key_that_is_not_the_party_s_or_a_high_s_signature #2
cases.refused: signatures[1]: the key is not one of the current manifest's owner_keys

cases.name: Quorum.test_a_key_that_is_not_the_party_s_or_a_high_s_signature #3
cases.refused: the heartbeat (signatures[0], a) signature is not a low-S P-256 signature

cases.name: Quorum.test_a_node_and_the_owner_mixed_algorithms_for_an_hour_at_most #2
cases.refused: a heartbeat the owner signed lives at most 3600 s (this one: 21600 s)

cases.name: Quorum.test_a_node_and_the_owner_mixed_algorithms_for_an_hour_at_most #3
cases.refused: a heartbeat the owner signed lives at most 3600 s (this one: 21600 s)

cases.name: Quorum.test_a_node_the_rule_does_not_name_does_not_count #1
cases.refused: the heartbeat is signed by a, c: 2 of a, b, owner are needed

cases.name: Quorum.test_a_quarantined_retired_or_stolen_node_does_not_count #1
cases.refused: the heartbeat is signed by a: 2 of a, b, c, owner are needed

cases.name: Quorum.test_a_quarantined_retired_or_stolen_node_does_not_count #3
cases.refused: the heartbeat is signed by a: 2 of a, b, c, owner are needed

cases.name: Quorum.test_a_quarantined_retired_or_stolen_node_does_not_count #5
cases.refused: the heartbeat is signed by a: 2 of a, b, c, owner are needed

cases.name: Quorum.test_a_signature_over_another_body_does_not_count #1
cases.refused: the heartbeat (signatures[1], b) signature does not verify

cases.name: Quorum.test_one_party_alone_never #1
cases.refused: the heartbeat is signed by a: 2 of a, b, c, owner are needed

cases.name: Quorum.test_one_party_alone_never #2
cases.refused: the heartbeat is signed by owner: 2 of a, b, c, owner are needed

cases.name: Quorum.test_the_owner_counts_once_whichever_of_its_keys #1
cases.refused: signatures[1]: party 'owner' is named twice or is not a name

cases.name: Quorum.test_the_owner_lifetime_never_loosens_the_manifest_bound #1
cases.refused: a heartbeat lives at most 21600 s under the current manifest (this one: 21601 s)
